documentation.content: The backend hit the Redis 'max number of clients reached' limit. This indicates a connection leak or that REDIS_MAX_CONNECTIONS/SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS x instance count exceeds the Redis tier's maxclients. Check pool sizing in fastapi_backend (websocket_manager.py, redis_manager.py, sse_manager.py, notification_cache.py) and consider lowering max-instances or upgrading the Redis tier.
